newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Rabobank denies Napoli bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Rabobank denies Napoli bid talk.

text.p: Dutch co-operative bank Rabobank Nederland BV said on Tuesday that reports it was considering a bid for Italy's Banco di Napoli were totally unfounded.
"The rumours are absolutely unfounded," a spokesman for Rabobank told Reuters.
Italian newspapers said Rabobank, Germany's Bayerische Landesbank and Britain's Natwest were thought to be considering separate bids for a 60 percent stake in Napoli.
The German and British banks have also denied the talk.
Napoli earlier said three Italian and three foreign institutions had expressed interest in the controlling stake but did not identify them.
